products.name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni Wireless Gaming Headset, two swappable batteries, OmniPlay base
specs: 2 swappable packs, rated up to 30 hours each (ANC off)
32 h 51 min on one pack over 2.4 GHz (SoundGuys)
Headset powers off; it turns back on by itself if the spare goes in within 8 seconds
Mixes up to 4 at once: 2× USB, Bluetooth and line-in
One model for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and mobile
Active noise cancelling with transparency mode
products.warranty: Term not stated on the SteelSeries product page; see SteelSeries support for the US warranty.
products.summary: SteelSeries' current swappable-battery headset. While you use one pack, the other charges in the base. The base mixes PC, console, Bluetooth and line-in audio at once.
products.fit: Players who game on a PC plus a PlayStation, Xbox or Switch and want Discord and game audio mixed, with noise cancelling and no charging downtime.
caveats: Sound stops during a battery swap. The headset powers back on by itself only if the swap takes 8 seconds or less.
No 3.5 mm cable in the box (SoundGuys, Notebookcheck).
SoundGuys found the default tuning sibilant, the mic slightly muffled and the leatherette cups warm after about an hour.
Notebookcheck says the ear cushions may be too small for some ears.
On 2026-11-14 White was in stock and Black was on backorder (estimated restock Nov 18).

products.name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset for PC & PlayStation, two hot-swappable batteries
specs: 2 hot-swappable packs, up to 22 hours each
Headset powers off; it turns back on by itself if the spare goes in within 8 seconds
Two systems connected to the base at once, toggled with a button
PC and PlayStation (the Xbox version is sold separately)
products.warranty: Term not stated on the SteelSeries product page; see SteelSeries support for the US warranty.
products.summary: The earlier SteelSeries swappable-battery headset. It uses the same two-pack system as the Omni, with shorter rated battery life and no source mixing.
products.fit: PC and PlayStation players who want swappable batteries from SteelSeries and find it well below list price.
caveats: A long-term owner (Club386) says the base plays one source at a time, the base screen can't be turned off, and the headband lost tension over months.
Buy the Xbox version if you play on Xbox; this PC/PlayStation version is a different model.

Winners by segment: PC plus a console with mixed audio -> Omni (one model for all platforms, 4-source mix, ANC, 339 g); never-stop or budget -> Glorious InfinitePlay (no program, plain maker link); longest pack with ANC on one platform -> Turtle Beach Stealth Pro II (no program).
